name: GoogleTiles
description: Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles streamed onto the Cesium globe. Globe only.

supportedData.label: Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles
supportedData.description: Google's global photorealistic 3D mesh, streamed from the Google Map Tiles API. Needs a Google API key with the Map Tiles API enabled.
supportedData.procurement: Create an API key in Google Cloud with the Map Tiles API enabled, restricted to your MMGIS domains.

components.name: Layer Name
components.description: A display name for the layer.

components.name: Initial Visibility
components.description: Whether the layer is on initially.

components.name: Google API Key
components.description: A Google Cloud API key with the Map Tiles API enabled. Restrict it to the Map Tiles API and to your MMGIS domains in the Google Cloud console.

components.name: Max Screen Space Error
components.description: Level of detail. Lower is sharper but loads more tiles. Default 16.

components.name: Hide Globe Surface
components.description: Hide the plain globe while this layer is on, so it does not show through the mesh. Default on.
